MVS_usage: Explicitly authorized existing-cache auxiliary diagnostic only
scale: exp(median(log(GT)-log(pred))) on all finite-positive Calibration0000 GT pixels, one scale per restoration view
GT_mask: finite strictly positive raw EXR; no prediction-dependent mask
zero_depth_policy: Retain finite nonnegative depths, zero error=1 in AbsRel; strict original GT gate remains failed
percentile: (average_rank - 0.5)/number_of_finite_pixels, separately for each signal and image, over the entire predicted grid before reading GT; not normalized over GT-valid mask
ranking_metrics: frozen original AUROC / AP / tie-averaged raw AbsRel AUSE / Spearman
aggregation: Equal-frame macro; single evaluation sequence; no pixel-iid CI or generalization claim
regression: one-dimensional increasing isotonic AbsRel map per method, calibration stride8 GT-valid grid only, evaluate all valid sequence0001 pixels; constant calibration mean/median baselines
probability_mapping: one-dimensional nonnegative-slope logistic per method, same calibration stride8 grid, no test refit; constant calibration prevalence baseline
probability_scores: Brier, stable-logit NLL, ECE10 equal-width bins
VIPER_spatial_high_risk: per-method image q80 threshold including ties; record actual fraction; 8-connected component size/HHI
agreement: native and flip percentile >=0.8 / <=0.2; XOR high-risk disagreement and high-versus-low conflicts
